News Release
President Marcos confirms changes in Cabinet
October 11, 2026

President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. confirmed Sunday changes to some Cabinet members.

In a media interview in Singapore, President Marcos said he accepted the resignation of Department of Information Technology (DICT) Secretary Henry Aguda but noted that the DICT chief will stay on temporarily until a replacement is chosen.

“Yes, but we were withholding that; we were holding it back until we found the… we were able to announce also his replacement,” the President said when asked about Aguda’s departure.

President Marcos added that People’s Television Network (PTV4) General Manager Lino Cayetano will be appointed secretary of the Presidential Communications Office, succeeding PCO Secretary Dave Gomez, who was bypassed by the Commission on Appointments.

When asked about the effectivity of the Cabinet movement, the President said, “When we get back. It’s really just a question of formalizing everything.”

Asked if DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon will be returning to the Department of Transportation (DOTr), President Marcos said, “No, right now it’s a no. But it’s not… all of this is… you know, we can still change, we can still change. But as we sit here together today, no, it’s not moving.” | PND
